detailed_descriptions.en: Buggos 2 is a low-micro swarm RTS where YOU play the Evil Hivemind . Grow a base of living spawners, point them at the dirty Humans and watch up to 5,000 bugs pour over their walls. You don't micro single bugs. Set an Attack Pin for each spawner and the swarm marches, splits and floods around defenses on its own. RTS veterans still get control groups and chained pins when they want tighter control. Every mission earns evolution points to spend on 127 evolutions and mutations . Reset the tree whenever you like and try another build: a Swarmer flood, Spore Artillery sieges, Wasp raids over the walls, Brain Bugs that turn Humans against their own base, or Boom Slugs that explode inside Human lines. Mutations change how a unit works, not just its numbers. 45 missions across 9 planets , every map hand-built with chokepoints, back doors and alternate routes. Paint the ground in Goo, flank with fliers and find the path the Humans forgot to wall off. Crank up the difficulty and the Humans evolve too: after each planet you choose how they adapt to your swarm. Buggos aren't the only ones who evolve anymore. Buggos vs Buggos multiplayer Up to 4 players fight over Steam, free-for-all or in teams. Everyone drafts their own evolutions and mutations from a point budget the host sets, then the swarms collide. Lose your last Hive and you're out. More ways to play Survival mode: hold out against endless Human waves and earn an evolution point every wave. Level editor and Steam Workshop: build your own maps, script them with triggers and share them. 6 languages: English, French, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Latin American Spanish. The stars await their true masters. Conquer Buggos 2 today.

You don't micro single bugs. Set an Attack Pin for each spawner and the swarm marches, splits and floods around defenses on its own. RTS veterans still get control groups and chained pins when they want tighter control.

Every mission earns evolution points to spend on 127 evolutions and mutations. Reset the tree whenever you like and try another build: a Swarmer flood, Spore Artillery sieges, Wasp raids over the walls, Brain Bugs that turn Humans against their own base, or Boom Slugs that explode inside Human lines. Mutations change how a unit works, not just its numbers.

45 missions across 9 planets, every map hand-built with chokepoints, back doors and alternate routes. Paint the ground in Goo, flank with fliers and find the path the Humans forgot to wall off.

Crank up the difficulty and the Humans evolve too: after each planet you choose how they adapt to your swarm. Buggos aren't the only ones who evolve anymore.

Buggos vs Buggos multiplayer

More ways to play

  • Level editor and Steam Workshop: build your own maps, script them with triggers and share them.

  • 6 languages: English, French, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Latin American Spanish.

The stars await their true masters. Conquer Buggos 2 today.
